releaseNotes:
v0.3.1 - first packaged release.
 - Controller, Viewport, Doorbell and Event Stream drivers on the official local Protect Integration API.
 - Real-time viewer, camera and ring updates.
 - Security hardening: IPv4-only console address, Protect ID checks, debug logging turns itself off.
See CHANGELOG.md for details.
author: Michael Dailous

drivers.name: UniFi Protect Controller
drivers.description: Parent device: console address and API key, discovery, real-time updates.

drivers.name: UniFi Protect Viewport
drivers.description: One device per Protect viewer: current liveview and liveview switching.

drivers.name: UniFi Protect Doorbell
drivers.description: One device per doorbell camera: each ring is button 1 pushed.

drivers.name: UniFi Protect Event Stream
drivers.description: Created automatically: the one live connection to Protect's events feed.
